A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Human Gaussian Model (HGM). Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support a reliable comparison; the omitted appendix figures in v4 are actual document changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original novel-view synthesis and mesh-reconstruction experiments, quantitative component ablations in Tables 1–4, and qualitative comparisons in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Tables 1–4 and numerous qualitative reconstruction and ablation results.

M1.justification: The dual-branch HGM, iterative SMPL-X refinement, ControlNet back-view refinement, two-view reconstruction, training losses, and mesh-refinement procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain THuman2.0, CustomHumans, and HuMMan evaluations, plus THuman2.1 and in-the-wild visualizations. Loose clothing and challenging poses remain represented, including in Figure 1; the deleted appendix figures remove additional qualitative cases within this retained coverage.

E2.justification: Deleting appendix Figures 12–14 removes comparisons against PIFu, SIFU, SiTH, and LGM on the illustrated difficult cases. PIFu consequently disappears from the reported empirical comparisons, although its citation remains. Comparator membership in Tables 1–3 is unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported training data, evaluation splits, 45-scan CustomHumans evaluation, camera configuration, image resolution, metrics, and training budget are unchanged. No separate protocol revision accompanies the removal of supplementary visual examples.

E4.justification: v4 removes the supplementary loose-clothing case studies in Figures 12–13 and extreme-pose HuMMan comparison in Figure 14. The quantitative component ablations, SMPL-X refinement analysis, and four qualitative ablation examples in Figure 8 remain; Figure 8 is rearranged rather than replaced by a new analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests. The tables retain the same single-value reporting practice.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 are unchanged. v4 removes the qualitative result entries in Figures 12–14 and their accompanying descriptions of clothing recovery, body shrinkage, unnatural colors, and blurry baseline renderings.

T1.justification: The Gaussian representation, mathematical formulation, and Equations 1–6 are unchanged. Neither version adds distinct theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about the reconstruction pipeline, structural and diffusion priors, SMPL-X refinement, generalization, and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: The explanations involving structural priors, SMPL-X alignment, and back-view refinement remain unchanged, as does the limitation concerning hands and faces. The deleted appendix prose describes omitted qualitative outcomes rather than withdrawing a distinct mechanism explanation or applicability qualification.

D1.justification: Section 3.6 and the appendix retain the same architecture details, hyperparameters, optimization iterations, hardware, software versions, training and reconstruction times, and project-access information.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the 40 referenced works are unchanged. Removing PIFu's empirical comparisons does not alter the retained discussion of its relationship to prior human-reconstruction research.

P1.justification: The main narrative is unchanged. v4 removes the appendix paragraph discussing Figures 12–14 and makes limited organizational adjustments around the appendix opening and remaining paragraphs.

P2.justification: v4 removes the entire three-figure supplementary comparison series, Figures 12–14. Figure 8 changes from two labeled rows to smaller adjacent comparison pairs with revised highlighting, and the remaining appendix is reflowed. These substantially alter the supplementary visual presentation while preserving the numerical tables.

improvement.justification: Figure 8's adjacent pairs now match its caption, and the appendix has cleaner paragraph placement. However, deleting Figures 12–14 removes useful comparative evidence for difficult clothing and poses, including all displayed PIFu results, while the broad generalization claims remain. With the method and quantitative evidence unchanged, this produces a limited net loss of evidential support.
